source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current mbox ChangeKeywords obtains the typed token, parses it with ToInteger64 and checks rv before seeking. Maildir uses its token as a cur/ filename and rejects an empty token. This supports a scoped implementation rule: keep interpretation inside the backend and validate conversion before byte access. It is not a claim that every migrated native caller checks every return; the historical MAPI path did not add equivalent conversion-status handling, and its runtime behavior was not established.
title: Parse mbox tokens at the backend boundary and check conversion status
